mentions.name: Stray Animal Rescue Platform
mentions.description: A mobile-first platform for proactively helping stray dogs and cats. When you see an animal in need in an unfamiliar area, sharing your GPS location automatically surfaces the nearest clinics, relevant government institutions, phone numbers of people monitoring for such cases, and local Facebook groups to post on, so the animal gets into the right hands. The platform also explores automatically posting to a Facebook group whenever a signal is received, and prioritizes being easy to use so people actually adopt it.
mentions.problem: People who see an animal in need in an unfamiliar area lack a quick way to connect it with nearby clinics, authorities, monitors, and local groups that can help; the platform also faces the challenge of being mobile-first and easy enough to use for widespread adoption.
mentions.audience: People who encounter stray dogs or cats in need in unfamiliar areas and want to get the animal into the right hands
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building a platform for helping stray dogs/cats pro actively. The idea is whenever you see an animal in need in an unfamiliar area, you can use it to help the animal get into the right hands. Meaning that you share your GPS and it automatically sends you the nearest clinics, relevant government institution, phone numbers of people that are monitoring for such things and local facebook groups that you can post on.
